about: The tractus of the formulary “First Passion Sunday” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Often have they fought against me from my youth. Let Israel now say: often have they fought against me from my youth. Yet they could not prevail against me; the sinners wrought upon my back. They prolonged their iniquities; the just Lord hath cut the necks of sinners.
g: often, oft, oftimes, many times, frequently
